instructions_to_main_agent: Build a White-Label Hotel Booking Engine module suitable for MyHotelBox PMS.

CRITICAL: Adhere strictly to the color palette. Use #0A4297 (Deep Blue) for trust elements/header and #006CE4 (Action Blue) for CTAs to mimic the Booking.com secure feel. Do NOT use default tailwind blues.
Implement a step-by-step booking flow (Search -> Room Selection -> Guest Details -> Confirm). Use a sticky 'Book Now' bar at the bottom for mobile.

For the Search Widget, use Shadcn Calendar for date selection and Shadcn Select/Popover for Guest/Room counts. Make the widget stark white with a crisp 1px border and strong shadow against the hero image.
Include 'Trust Signals' aggressively: ShieldCheck icons next to checkout, 'Free Cancellation' green badges on room cards, and secure payment logos.
Include 'Urgency Signals': Hardcode some realistic urgency text like 'Only 2 rooms left on our site!' in #D32F2F (Red).
For the Landing Page Template, structure it: Hero (with embedded widget) -> Rooms (Cards) -> Amenities -> Location/Map (placeholder) -> Reviews.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='room-search-button').
